bail_facts.text: The charge sheet has been filed and the investigation is complete.
The applicant has an address and has given his statement to the police.
The dispute arises from a business transaction, and the cheque transaction is being dealt with under section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881.
The offences are punishable with imprisonment of up to seven years.
The Public Prosecutor says that the applicant closed his shop and could not be traced for some days.
